name: Borja Giménez Larraz - § 55 - Am 54
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 55. Highlights that those affected by domestic violence should be given appropriate assistance by Member States, housing agencies and the private sector, such as temporary emergency accommodation in shelters and care centres, and that individuals should be offered safe, long-term and affordable housing solutions via swift administrative procedures; calls on the Commission to integrate gender-based violence considerations into EU housing policy, ensuring that funding under the European Social Fund Plus (ESF+) and other instruments prioritises safe housing solutions for survivors of violence and exploitation;
